title: Tranche 1C — Regression Studio in TerraForge standalone

truthLabel: Regression Studio wired as live standalone module in TerraForge (was PlaceholderModule, now lazy-loaded). Cross-parcel scope, no parcel-scoped leakage. Governed types define model spec, feature set, coefficient set, diagnostics, validation metrics, and IAAO-aligned qualification thresholds. Write lane = Forge. 4 views: model list, new run, version compare, model detail with coefficient review.
